description:
Validate a domain's XML sitemap: presence, accessibility, URL count, lastmod freshness, sitemap-index handling, and image/video sitemap extensions.

Read-only. Issues N+1 HTTP GETs: one for robots.txt + sitemap, then up to `max_urls_to_check` HEADs against sampled URLs.

Deterministic, rule-based; no LLM.

When to use: site-wide indexing audits. Pair with `check_robots` for a full pre-crawl picture. For per-page checks, use `audit_page` or `check_technical` instead.

domain.description: Hostname or origin to inspect. Examples: `example.com`, `https://example.com`. The tool tries `/sitemap.xml` then the sitemap URL declared in robots.txt; follows sitemap index files one level deep. Read-only HTTP GETs against the domain only.

max_urls_to_check.description: Cap on how many URLs from the sitemap to sample for lastmod, image/video extension, and structural checks. Default 100. Increase up to 500 for large sites where you want a more representative sample; each extra URL is one HTTP HEAD.

name: check_sitemap

domain.description: The hostname the sitemap was checked for.

fetched_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the check.

category.description: Finding category - which AI-SEO dimension it relates to.

estimated_impact.description: Estimated impact on AI citation probability when resolved.

failure_signal.description: Falsifiability: the observable signal that would prove the fix did NOT work.

leading_indicator.description: Falsifiability: the leading indicator to monitor to confirm the fix is landing.

severity.description: Triage priority: critical blocks AI citation, warning hurts probability, info is nice-to-have.

where.description: Location of the issue (CSS selector, JSON-LD path, robots.txt line, or 'page-level').

sitemap_url.description: Resolved sitemap URL (null when status != found).

total_urls.description: Total URLs declared across the sitemap (and indexed children).

urls_with_lastmod.description: Count of URLs that carry a lastmod attribute.

title: Check XML sitemap health
